responseTemplates: I can help. What are you stuck with?

intents.goal: The learner wants to make a new driving lesson booking.
examples: How do I book a lesson?
Can I arrange another driving lesson?
I want to book my next lesson
Can you take me to the lesson booking area?
I need to book driving lessons
Where can I make a booking?
Can I arrange my next driving lesson?
I want to set up another lesson
responseTemplates: You can book a lesson from the booking area in your learner dashboard. Use the button below and I will take you there.
To book another lesson, open the booking area in your learner dashboard and choose an instructor or available slot.
visitorResponseTemplates: You can start booking from LDA, but you will need a learner account before checkout. Sign in or create a learner account, then continue into lesson booking.

intents.goal: The learner wants a lesson as soon as possible.
examples: I want a lesson right now
responseTemplates: Use Book On Demand when you want a lesson as soon as an instructor is available. I can take you straight to that booking flow.

intents.goal: The learner wants to arrange a future lesson or choose a time slot.
examples: I want to pick a future date
Can I arrange a lesson for later?
Where do I choose a time slot?
responseTemplates: You can schedule a lesson from the booking area in your learner dashboard. Choose an instructor, pick a slot, then continue through the normal booking steps.
visitorResponseTemplates: You can choose a future lesson time from Schedule Lessons. If you are not signed in, LDA will ask you to sign in or create a learner account before checkout.

intents.goal: The learner wants to find an instructor and book a lesson.
examples: How can I find an instructor and book?
responseTemplates: You can find an instructor from the booking area in your learner dashboard, then choose a lesson time and continue to checkout.
visitorResponseTemplates: To find and book an instructor, create or sign in to a learner account first. Then LDA can take you through instructor search and booking.

intents.goal: The learner is asking about an existing booking or lesson record problem.
examples: The booking reference does not work
My lesson disappeared from my dashboard
responseTemplates: Open your learner calendar or booking history first to check the lesson status. If it is still missing, I will need the booking reference if you have one.
visitorResponseTemplates: Sign in to your learner account first so LDA can show your booking history and calendar. If the lesson is still missing after signing in, keep the booking reference ready if you have one.

intents.goal: The learner wants to understand or start a refund for a lesson payment.
examples: How do I get a refund?
Can I get my money back?
I need a refund for a lesson
I paid and need a refund
How does the refund process work?
Where do I request a refund?
responseTemplates: Refunds are handled through Payment Help. Open the lesson payment record, choose the refund option, and LDA will show whether it can be processed automatically or needs review.

articles.title: Getting started before signing in
articles.summary: Guests can create a learner account, log in, preview Smart Match, or contact guest support.
articles.body: Guests can use public pages for Smart Match previews, learner sign-up, instructor application information, policies, and public support. Guests cannot view learner bookings, instructor calendars, payment receipts, or account-specific data until signed in.

articles.title: Book a new lesson
articles.summary: Learners book new lessons from the booking area in the learner dashboard.
articles.body: For a new booking, open the booking area in the learner dashboard. The learner can find an instructor, choose a lesson or slot, and continue through secure checkout. Do not ask for a booking reference unless the learner is asking about an existing booking problem.

articles.title: Manage learner bookings
articles.summary: Learners use the calendar and booking history to view existing lessons.
articles.body: Open the learner calendar or booking history when a learner needs to view, check, reschedule, or troubleshoot an existing lesson. If a booking is missing, ask for the booking reference only if one exists.

articles.title: Payment and refund help
articles.summary: Payment Help handles confirmations, failed payments, duplicate charges, refunds and receipts.
articles.body: Use Payment Help for payment confirmation, failed card payment, duplicate charge, refund, receipt or invoice. Do not ask for full card details.

articles.title: Smart Match learner guidance
articles.summary: Smart Match helps learners find verified instructors based on preferences, availability, area and fit.
articles.body: Smart Match should ask about how the learner learns best, schedule timing, transmission, location and preferences rather than diagnoses.

articles.title: Off-platform payment requests
articles.summary: Off-platform payment requests must be refused and escalated with context.
articles.body: If a learner says an instructor asked for cash, bank transfer, WhatsApp payment or a private booking outside LDA, tell them not to pay outside LDA. Platform protection only applies to bookings and payments completed through LDA.

articles.title: Website issue support
articles.summary: Website issues should capture page, device and exact error before sending to LDA support.
articles.body: For broken pages, blank screens, slow loading, menu issues or application errors, ask which page they were on, what they clicked, device/browser and the exact error shown. Suggest refreshing once, then create a support ticket if it continues.
